name: Thumbnail Store
description: ThumbnailStore, the disk preview store: opaque encoded preview bytes keyed by PreviewKey (asset, content token, SizeClass), PreviewEntry with its VolumeRef and relative path, and Availability (online or offline). The store writes, reads and removes previews in its folder (PreviewFiles: index.json plus index.journal plus digest-named p/<2 hex>/<16 hex>.bin files, each a versioned header naming its key, volume and path ahead of the payload, replaced by temp file and rename under an exclusive flock) and holds them to a byte budget by least-recently-used eviction. A change appends only the entries it touched to the journal (PreviewJournal), each store catches up on the lines others appended, and the journal is compacted into a fresh snapshot once it holds more than half as many records as there are entries, so index I/O per write is O(1) amortised. Reads flush the entries they bumped at most every 2 s and on close, merged with the index on disk. PreviewIndex is the snapshot codec and its recovery: a version 1 index still loads; an index that is damaged, of a newer version or with a damaged journal is set aside as index.damaged.json and rebuilt from the files' headers, orphan temp files and entries whose file is gone are cleared at open. OfflineVolumes lists one volume's entries by volume id and reports an entry offline when its volume id is not among the mounted ones, while its bytes still read; an entry with no volume is always online.
